speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; to help me understand your condition, how many days old were you when these symptoms first started?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) due to prematurity. Given the infant was born at 33 weeks and presents with respiratory distress only 2 hours after birth, this is a classic presentation of surfactant deficiency. I recommend requesting a Chest X-Ray to confirm the presence of ground-glass opacities and air bronchograms typical of RDS.
